executive_summary: Binding baseline forensic audit; diagnostics cannot become submission candidates.
data: Full canonical ledger. No price/features.npy/text/macro/source inputs loaded.
target: truth - original median; divide by original actual SD. Original draws, mature truths and loss normalization unchanged.
purge: Original LOCATION01 purged_mask: origin before Jan1(test start)-189BD and target_end before Jan1. Tests 2010–2013,2014–2017,2018–2020,2021–2024; no alternative fold selected.
rolling: Calendar-year lookback; train origins before t-189BD, targets matured before t. Minimum one observation; report all eligible origins, counts and missing early windows. No tuned windows.
oracle_optimizer: Bisection of weighted absolute-distance derivative; 80 iterations or relative bracket 1e-10. Shared scorer evaluates location-only minimum. Weights SD/scale/n_draws; no oracle value enters training.

universes.eval: All inherited purged-fold test cells 2010–2024; separate same-ledger oracles for captures.

controls.matched_random: Permutation of global predicted sign vector; exact positive frequency; zero retained.
controls.year: Train-only annual signs shuffled within fold. Last shuffled historical annual sign applied to whole held-out fold. Technical clarification prevents future-training leakage from permuting later fits backward.
controls.asset: Train-only asset signs permuted across asset labels.
controls.horizon: Train-only horizon signs permuted across horizon labels.
controls.degenerate: If matched random is degenerate, cannot establish superiority; global gate fails.

bootstrap.sampling: Whole original blocks sampled equally with replacement; ratios of sums. Bias stats full ledger; predictive/oracle capture matched eval ledger. Conditional on frozen fits/oracles; no refit.
bootstrap.oracle_capture: Low-dimensional GLOBAL oracle headroom / perfect headroom on eval; separately predictive global capture.

decision_gates.structured: global material/robust support weak; >=2 stable assets OR >=2 stable horizons, its corresponding full test score <1 and >=3/4 folds improve; no era >70%.
decision_gates.episode: Full constant-up year/era concentration plus era majority reversal, global chronological ratio >=1 and recent parent positive >=55%.
decision_gates.no_stable: Full positive within5pp of50 and both origin/year CIs include50; global crossfit ratio>=1; all lowdim full oracle captures<10%; recent parent positive exceeds full UST2/5 by>=5pp.
decision_gates.fallback: INCONCLUSIVE -> ALPHA-STRATEGY-RESET-05, due failure to separate global/structure/episode under exposed dependence.

public_firewall: Truth/draws/per-cell losses private. Public aggregate oracle diagnostics explicitly requested by user. No per-cell oracle estimates or realized answers published.
